claims.statement: A HAK check-evidence binding policy is bound to the exact qualification-plan content and workflow and covers exactly the plan obligations without duplicate, missing, or unknown obligation bindings.

ProviderBound check evidence can satisfy a precommitted obligation only when its provider job name, step name, step number, and terminal conclusions match the exact selector fixed by the binding policy.
A later successful provider step cannot be substituted post hoc for a different precommitted obligation selector without validation failure.
Canonical binding-policy digest validation detects the tested forms of post-materialization policy tampering.

required_checks.description: Resolve, checkout, and assert the exact PR head.
Compile inherited HAK evidence stack plus scripts/hak_check_binding_lint.py under Python 3.12.
Lint the HAK-010 machine-readable qualification plan.
Lint the HAK-010 precommitted obligation-to-job/step binding policy against the exact HAK-010 plan.
Validate HAK-010 schema syntax and representative binding-policy documents with Draft 2020-12 jsonschema.
Run focused HAK-010 binding-policy and schema regression suites.

required_negative_cases: strict conformance uses provider evidence that does not satisfy precommitted selector

independence.claim_interpretation: limited to HAK-010 precommit/binding tooling behavior; semantic adequacy of chosen selectors remains reviewable
